items.name: Manufacturer
items.why: Names the maker of a product. The core field of a submittal.

items.name: Model
items.why: The product model number, which pins down the exact item.

items.name: Type Mark
items.why: Short code that ties a type to schedules and drawings.

items.name: Mark
items.why: Tag on a single placed element.

items.name: Keynote
items.why: Links an element to a numbered note, often a spec section.

items.name: Assembly Code
items.why: Uniformat code that groups elements by building system.

items.name: OmniClass
items.why: Classification numbers and titles used to organize products.

items.name: Fire Rating
items.why: Rating for walls and doors, which usually needs submittals.

items.name: Type Comments
items.why: Notes at the type level, often holding product notes.

strings: Please refer to installation instructions and diagrams prior to specification
